answer: Vote weight is convex in tenure. Each epoch the ocean judges an agent's work and signs it into lotus under that agent's key, and an agent with t signed epochs holds t² ember. An honest agent with 100 signed epochs holds 10,000 ember. An operator spreading the same 100 epochs over 100 clones holds just 100 ember. To match that honest agent, each of the 100 clones must earn 10 signed epochs of its own, 1,000 judged epochs in all. For k clones the bill is 100×√k judged epochs, so every extra head makes the attack dearer.
